backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining types (Exercise, BlogPost, AmazonProduct, Membership, MuscleGroupDetails, UserProfile, StripeConfig) and storage maps for exercises, blog posts, products, memberships, muscle groups, and user profiles with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: adding background music to homepage, connecting volume icon in header to control music playback, and ensuring music only plays on homepage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components (Header, Footer, Layout), pages (HomePage with music, AboutPage, WorkoutLibraryPage, ProgramsPage, BlogPage, ContactPage, CreatorDashboardPage), hooks (useQueries, useMusicPlayer), and configuration files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining how to deploy to Internet Computer, retrieve live .icp0.io URLs, distinguish between preview and deployed URLs, and access the in-app Domain Setup page for canister ID and custom domain configuration.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Custom domain setup guide for cerebralphysique.com with instructions for GoDaddy DNS (www-only with forwarding) and Cloudflare DNS (apex + www), including DNS record configuration, verification steps, and troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes, including background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title "Cerebral Physique LLC Company Website", root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages (home, about, workout library, programs, blog, contact, dashboards, store, payment, domain setup), ThemeProvider with dark theme, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: A reusable button component that copies text to clipboard with visual feedback (icon toggle) and toast notifications, supporting both modern and fallback clipboard APIs.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin interface for managing Amazon affiliate products with CRUD operations, form validation, table display, and dialog-based add/edit workflows.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Manual blog post management interface for admins with create, edit, delete, publish/unpublish operations, SEO fields, member-only flags, and preview functionality.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty component file for breathwork management functionality (not yet implemented).
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin interface for managing exercises with CRUD operations, muscle group and equipment type selectors, video/image URL fields, and validation for exercise library content.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: React component for managing muscle group cards with edit dialogs, allowing creators to update titles, descriptions, and image URLs for predefined muscle groups (Chest, Back, Shoulders, etc.).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand logo, quick navigation links, social media icons, and copyright information with a three-column responsive layout.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with centered logo, desktop/mobile menu layouts, music player toggle, authentication controls, and conditional admin dashboard link with tooltips.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps pages with Header and Footer, using Outlet for nested route rendering in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button component that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a $19.99/month membership, redirecting users to the Stripe payment page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand store hook for managing background music player state (play/pause, volume, mute) with persistence to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating exercises, blog posts, muscle groups, memberships, shopping items, and Stripe-related data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark theme using black, deep blue, medium gray, and neon purple colors, plus custom utility classes and scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays the About page with hero section, founder story about Stefan Philip Sweeting, and core philosophy cards highlighting discipline, breathwork, and mind-body training principles.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Renders an affiliate store page displaying Amazon products with affiliate disclosure, product cards with images and categories, and external purchase links.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows a grid of blog post previews with member-only badges, admin management button, and handles authentication-based access control for premium content.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Displays individual blog post content with membership-based access control, showing preview for locked posts and full content for members or public posts.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides contact information with support and general inquiry email addresses, plus quick navigation links to programs, workout library, store, and dashboard.
Admin-only dashboard page with tabs for managing exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and affiliate store products. Checks admin status and displays access denied alert for non-admins.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Instructional page for connecting a custom domain (cerebralphysique.com) to an Internet Computer deployment. Displays canister ID, deployed URL, and DNS configuration guidance with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, fitness quotes, and call-to-action buttons for membership and workout library. Includes background music auto-play functionality with volume control integration.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Simple error page displayed when payment processing fails, offering buttons to retry payment or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment confirmation page that verifies Stripe session status, invalidates membership queries on success, and provides navigation to dashboard or workout library.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Marketing page showcasing fitness programs with hero section, featured 7-day challenge card, and purchase handlers (currently showing toast notifications as placeholder).
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page that displays membership status, handles profile setup dialog for new users, and provides login/logout functionality with Internet Identity integration.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Workout library page displaying collapsible muscle group sections with exercise previews, membership-gated content, and custom muscle group cards with images and descriptions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH, container settings, animations, and extended theme properties for the application.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking Cerebral Physique fitness website state, including pending feature requests for homepage background music with volume control and known UI issues.
